main_text.p: cum quo confer 2.Par.25.24. Constr. בְּאַסְפֵי הַשְּׁעָרִים In congregationibus portarum, Neh.12.25.
אַסְפַּסְף [?] m. Collecta turba, Colluvies, unde cum Aleph quiescente, והאספסף Et colluvies, Num.11.4.

אָסַר Ligavit, Obligavit, Vincivit. Particip. אָסְרִי Ligans, Gen.49.11. cum ' paragogico. Particip. Praeter. הָסוּרִים Vincti, Eccl.4.14. contract. pro הָאֲסוּרִים Vide simile supra in אלף. Niph. Imper. הֵאָסְרוּ Vincti estote, Genes.42.16. Futur. יֵאָסֵר Vinciatur, Vinctus esto, v.19. Pyh. אֲסְרוּ Vincti sunt, Jes.22.3.
אסר m. Idem, v.4. Plural. cum Aff. וְאֻסְרָיָה [?] Et obligationes ejus, v.6.
אסור m. Vinculum, Ligamen, Jerem.37.15. Plural. אסוריו Vincula ejus, Jud.15.14.
אסיר m. Vinctus, Psalm.79.11. Plural. אסירים Vincti, Psalm.68.7. Construct. אסירי Zach.9.12. Aff. אסיריך Vinctos tuos, v.11.
מסרת f. Vinculum, Ezech.20.37. contractè pro מאסרת, Sic מכולת pro מאכולת, ut est in אכל.
אסור Chald. Vinculum, Dan.4.12, Plural. ולאסורין Et ad vincula, Esr.7.26.
אסרא Chald. Interdictum, quasi Vinculum di-ctum, Dan.6.7.8.
אַעָא [?] m. Chald. Lignum, Esrae 5.v.8. Dan.5.4. idem quod Hebraeum עֵץ, commutato צ in ץ, quod saepius fit.
אַף Etiam, Quinetiam, Quoque: אַף־כִּי Quanto-minus, 1.Reg.8.27, Quanto magis, Proverb.11.31.

page.notes: Running head is Hebrew headwords "אם" and "אע"; uncertain on order and vowels. Several Hebrew headwords and vowel points are approximated and marked [?] where the scan is unclear, especially in the entries for אַסְפַּסְף, אֹסֶר, וְאֻסְרָיָה, and אַעָא. The Hebrew in the first line and the contracted forms in the "אסר" entry are copied from the scan without verification. Large initial letters are Hebrew headword letters and are transcribed as the entry word.
